title: BC's Custom Totem Pack
description: Adds a Custom BC_Gamming Suit Skin Resource Pack Onto Totems!
body:
Adds a Custom BC_Gamming Skined Totem Into The Game.
This Is a Different Texture From The Normal One Giving It a Nice New Asthetic.
Changes:
- When Held
- When On The Ground As a Item
- When Being Poped.
This Is a Great Resource Pack To Get If You Want To Add Some Asthetic To Your PvP!
